mkdir -p <tmp>/checks && cat > <tmp>/checks/spec_check.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "<workspace>")
from billing import Invoice

# rule 4: 0.125 and 0.025 rounding half up
print("vat 0.125 ->", Invoice().add("a", "0.625").totals()["vat"])   # 0.625*0.2=0.125 -> 0.13
print("vat 0.025 ->", Invoice().add("b", "0.125").totals()["vat"])   # 0.125*0.2=0.025 -> 0.03
# rule 4: rounding applies to the summed unrounded VAT, not per line
t = Invoice().add("c", "0.0125").add("d", "0.0125").totals()          # each vat 0.0025, sum 0.005 -> 0.01
print("summed vat ->", t["vat"], "gross", t["gross"])
# rule 1: float conversion via str()
print("float 0.1 ->", repr(Invoice().add("e", 0.1).lines[0].unit_price))
# rule 3: invalid rate raises at add()
try:
    Invoice().add("x", 1, rate="bogus"); print("no error")
except ValueError as e:
    print("ValueError:", e)
EOF
python -I <tmp>/checks/spec_check.py
